description: List the user's mailbox (their <userId>@mosadd.com inbox/outbox) newest-first, with sender, subject, status and a short snippet. Filter by direction ('inbound' = received, 'outbound' = sent). Use the returned next_cursor with `before` to page through older mail. Call mAYL_view to read a full message body.

before.description: Pagination cursor: pass the previous response's next_cursor to get the next (older) page.

direction.description: Filter to received (inbound) or sent (outbound) mail. Omit for both.

name: mAYL_list
